selected_descriptive_example.selection_note: Illustrative interpretation after the complete analysis, not a newly selected detection rule. All twelve features, all six codec settings and all six processing conditions remain in the full aggregate.
selected_descriptive_example.contrast: Feature of processed codec-derived copy minus feature of equally processed baseline
selected_descriptive_example.meaning: The observed median contrast is largely retained after gain/dithering/resampling but much smaller after the low-pass pipeline and reduced by the EQ/dynamics pipeline. This is content- and setting-specific feature behavior, not classifier detection accuracy or evidence that all codec traces were erased.
selected_descriptive_example.causal_limit: The intervention includes the specified filter and output quantization/saturation. Do not attribute the result to an ideal unclipped filter alone.

saturation_accounting.policy: Prespecified: retain and count these cases, no retrospective normalization or source exclusion.

conclusion: The paired construction and audit machinery is reproducible, and non-codec processing can materially change codec-associated measurements. This supports testing nuisance robustness, not deploying a feature threshold or declaring the untrained CNN successful or failed.
scope_limits: Unknown library ancestry cannot supply verified clean negatives or an ever-lossy false-positive denominator.
Four controlled synthesis recipes do not establish transfer to independent real-world finished music.
